children: a public offering of $350 million in aggregate principal amount of notes due 2031.
The notes carry a 6.750% annual coupon rate payable semi-annually and were issued at 98.985% of par to yield 6.994% at maturity.
Net proceeds will initially be used to repay a portion of the outstanding debt under the company's senior secured revolving credit facility.
The company intends to later re-borrow under the credit facility to fund new middle-market investments and cover general corporate expenses.
The transaction is scheduled to close on September 15, 2026.
